svg.text: Today: the conversations drawer as it ships
Filtered to the current file. This is the baseline the two alternatives are judged against, not a proposal.
Every row above is painted by github_conversation_delegate.cpp:68-144: heading, body, then a facts line joined with " · ".
There are no lane rails and no git-graph rendering anywhere in the shipped code; BPR-0191 narrowed that language to mean filtering by thread.
Note the heading on every comment. A thread's first comment reads "Reply by" too, because the delegate asks whether the row has a parent and every comment's parent is the thread.
/// Pair rows of two documents by exact content first,
/// then by similarity within the remaining runs.
Selected line 214 carries two threads; line 288 carries a
third that GitHub has already marked outdated.
begin() on a const document returns a const_iterator already;
It does, but the overload set makes that accidental. Keep cbegin().
